rca of the issue: RP Locations duplicate React key warnings: location seed data contains template names (e.g., 'Ancient Market Square', 'Pelor Temple') replicated across many cities/nations. AdminDashboard's LocationsTab uses a name-derived slug as key (e.g., `${city}-${locName}`) which collides when (city, location-name) pairs repeat.
